adopted_contracts: Explicit model/source bytes and SHA, frame/DPI, pinned engine and one PSM3 recognition; no implicit weight download or automatic retry.
Retain full block/paragraph/line/word hierarchy, source index paths, text, confidence and pixel coordinates; independently map X/Y to explicit point frame.
Retain invalid/degenerate boxes and exceptional numeric diagnostics; preserve primary errors and partial files on atomic write failure.
No text replacement, vocabulary lookup, confidence selection, OCR/native merge, or Article assignment.

held_UnicodeInk64.independent_private_Unit_table_counterex: native_triangle_cells::restore still reads PDF-specific data-wmode/advance/nativebbox after layout; literal triangle moves cells.

quality_limits: Only two previously selected pages, two DPIs; no new random wholepage gold or accuracy claim.
Old paragraph scores are inherited only through exact recognizer text/hierarchy; extra LF and 144DPI boundary crossings remain.
Source image membership does not prove arbitrary clip/mask/overpaint visibility.
Existing native text/count/distance heuristics, issuer ownership, company mixed articles, and scale counterexamples remain unresolved.
